summary: Backend-only smoke test for e-navlog. Verified Clerk config, auth-gated /api/me (create + update), SimBrief import error handling, per-user flight isolation, waypoint toggle, reset, and delete. Pilot 392350 returned no OFP (SimBrief 400), which is acceptable per the spec; flight-dependent endpoints were therefore exercised against a synthetic flight inserted directly into Mongo for a Clerk test user.
passed: GET /api/me with valid Clerk JWT -> creates+returns PilotProfile
POST /api/flights/import without any configured pilot_id -> 400 'No SimBrief Pilot ID configured'
POST /api/flights/import with pilot_id='392350' -> 400 'SimBrief returned 400' (no OFP; acceptable per spec)
GET /api/flights returns only caller's flights (cross-user isolation verified)
notes: SimBrief pilot_id 392350 does not currently have a published OFP, so the happy-path parse of real SimBrief XML could not be executed end-to-end. The import endpoint correctly propagates SimBrief's 400 as HTTP 400. Recommend retesting with a pilot_id that has an active OFP to validate _parse_simbrief_xml against live XML.
Toggle/reset/delete were validated against a synthetic Mongo-inserted flight owned by a Clerk test user; all four endpoints returned expected shapes and status codes.
Clerk test users were created via Clerk Backend API with User-Agent header and deleted at end of run; their pilots/flights docs were also cleaned up.
action_items: Optional: provide a SimBrief pilot_id with an active OFP to fully exercise _parse_simbrief_xml on real XML.
